name: Abby
review: This was a last minute, one night stay, so we could attend a nearby family reunion. The place was perfect for our family and our elderly dog. Could not have been easier to find, to get into, and to settle right in. There is basically two master bedrooms, the upstairs is a queen sized bed with a full bathroom, king sized with shared bathroom downstairs. The bunk beds have a double on the bottom and twin up top, sturdy and functional even for my teenaged boys. There is a bonus room downstairs with a comfortable sectional and tv and a closing door, easily makes another bedroom space. The kitchen was well stocked with the standards and the keurig with k cups available saved us, getting us on the road for a longgggg drive the next morning!! Plenty of towels and linens and extra blankets. Comfortable and cozy, we didn’t use the fireplace but would be amazing in the winter. The views are unmatched from the balcony!!!  Loved the high top Adirondack set, we watched the sunset from those.

name: Adam
review: Beautiful location. Second time I've stayed there. Very nice.

name: Ye
review: Beautiful places for a big family. We really enjoyed the stay and the view!

name: Whitney
review: We had a great stay at Ryan's condo. The condo is large and spacious, and the views are spectacular. We would absolutely stay here again. Ryan was also great to communicate with and very accommodating.

name: Paul
review:
The view from the house was spectacular!
Peaceful, quiet, a perfect place to relax.
We couldn't ask for a more scenic location!
Thank you!

name: Jennifer
review: Beautiful views, we have stayed here before and loved it. This time seemed like housekeepers were slacking a little. Otherwise, we had a great stay, it is a gorgeous spot!

name: Kate
review: We stayed for two nights to spring ski, and the conditions on the mountain were great. We frequent Saddleback often and really enjoy the area. This condo was ski in/ski out, with a little walk to navigate through to the lifts. The condo was spacious and comfortably fit our family of 5. The bunk beds were actually quite squeaky (as is mentioned in another review as well) which did worry our kids when they hopped into their beds. We weren't able to figure out the fireplace, but also didn't reach out to ask since we were only there for a few days. We had a snafu with the door keypad, but they quickly resolved the issue in a very timely manner.

name: Joseph
review: Great stay for Spring Bash at Saddleback. Would love to stay again!

name: Renee
review: Super comfortable, spacious, and cozy space with beautiful views and direct access to Saddleback’s ski trails. The kitchen was exceptionally well-stocked, making it easy to settle in and feel at home. The host was incredibly friendly, responsive, and helpful throughout the stay.

name: Sonja
review:
We had a fantastic stay in this beautiful condo. The views were magnificent and the apartment itself is extremely comfortable and spacious. We loved the vintage winter sports decor.  Check in and check out were super easy and access to the mountain is unbeatable- truly ski on /ski off.
We would absolutely stay again!

name: Brian
review: Incredible views and probably the best ski-in / ski-out access on the mountain. Very clean, organized and comfortable. Definitely a place I look forward to booking again next season.

name: Martha
review: We had a fabulous week in Ryan's condo.  We came to Saddleback for a week of skiing, and we were not disappointed.  The location of this condo is excellent; t's super easy to get to and from the slopes.  In addition, when we weren't skiing we had the most magnificent mountain views.  The condo is comfortable, well-equipped, and roomy.  And Ryan is very communicative and helpful.  We would definitely come back!

name: Stephanie
review: Will definitely look to stay here again. Lots of space, had just what we needed and more, plus you couldn’t beat the ski in/ski out access. My only regret is not booking for longer!

name: Joseph
review: Few places are “better than advertised”, this one definitely was. The views, the access to the mountain for skiing, the quiet and spacious setting…absolutely gorgeous. We will definitely seek to stay here again!

name: John
review:
We loved our family gathering at Ryan’s condo!  The view and large open concept made it really feel like a warm relaxing home for us.  The kitchen was well stocked with extra dish’s, mugs and glassware. The openness’s of working in the kitchen with the  bar top to the eating area was fantastic. 
  It was all topped off with a great ski in and out location. We can’t wait to return again. 
   Thanks!!

name: Kevin
review: Unit location is great - easy for ski-in / ski-out.  Ryan was very easy to work with in terms of check-in / check-out.  Clothes washer did not work well - left clothes sopping wet.  Carpet in basement is coming up.  Bunk bed (top bed) is extremely squeaky and feels unstable.  Mold in kitchen accessories.  Could be a great stay if a few of the issues above were addressed.  But, at peak winter pricing, we were surprised at some of the deficiencies.

name: Mary Catherine
review: Lovely ski-in/ski-out condo with cozy chalet vibes and an amazing view. Super easy access to the mountain and very well put together. Highly recommend as the perfect winter getaway!

name: Eunice
review: We loved our stay at Saddleback Mountain. Spacious, beautiful, and cozy for five of us. The ski in/ski out plus the gorgeous view of the mountains  and Saddleback lake were the icing on the cake.  It was our first time at this ski resort and we fell in love with this mountain. Ryan provided great info

name: Adam
review: Perfect stay for enjoying the beautiful mountain area, ski in and out at Saddleback was the perfect way to enjoy the slopes.

name: Robert
review: Ryan’s cabin was a perfect place to spend my bday. The views energy and atmosphere were perfect. I definitely plan to make a return visit!

name: Mary
review: We had a great time at Ryan’s condo. Impeccably clean and comfortable. Kitchen has everything you need. Beds were comfy. Me and my husband only stayed one night, but wish we could’ve stayed longer and brought some friends. Plenty of space for 2 couples + kids to stay. Amazing access to the slopes and the uphill trail, and not hard to find at all. Really appreciated the flexibility all-around. Ryan was super responsive too. Amazing host and can’t wait to come back.

name: Karla
review: Ryan’s chalet was perfection.   Amazing view of mountains and saddleback lake from every window and deck.    Decorated and furnished beautifully.   Comfy couches and monster comfy bed!  Nugget ice in the kitchen = extra special surprise!!!!   Dog friendly with a nice trail to a cute pond steps from door.    We were sad when it was time to pack up, we really really didn’t want to leave and hope to plan another visit soon!

name: Cynthia
review: This was our second stay at Ryan's place. We visited for a wedding in the area two years ago, and we enjoyed the location and Ryan's condo so much that we decided to spend nearly a week there this summer for a vacation with our extended family. Some of us hiked Saddleback and surrounding mountains by walking right out the door and up the mountain. Others of us walked to the ponds, hiked the Gnome Home Roam trails, and spent rainy afternoons in the children's area at the Rangeley library. We had many family meals around the big table and many enjoyable conversations in the family room, all while enjoying the beautiful views of Saddleback Lake far below.  Ryan went above and beyond to accommodate us, and we are grateful for our many happy memories of this vacation.

name: Kayla
review: Ryan’s place was the perfect weekend getaway and just what we were looking for. It’s very peaceful and quiet. The views from all the windows are picturesque. It’s about a 10 minute drive on backroads to a grocery store and 15 to restaurants on main st. The couch and beds were very comfortable and the kitchen had basic necessities to prep a meal. We wouldn’t hesitate to stay here again!

name: Rayanne
review: Our group of seven (4 adults and 3 children) loved our stay at this beautiful, mountain-side home! The location cannot be beat, the views are breathtaking (sunsets are especially stunning), and the kitchen amenities were perfect to prepare a homemade meal after skiing all day. The bedrooms are spacious and the bed linens are very comfortable. It was also immaculately clean when we arrived. All in all, this was a perfect weekend getaway! Our family enjoyed it so much, we’re already planning a return visit!

name: Daniel
review: We stayed here in early May , we are ski crazy and love saddleback in season. This was our first time out of the ski season, and just like winter we are hooked. The space is great with meandering views of mountains and lakes from every room. For a condo community it’s extremely quiet and peaceful. Access to hiking to the summit is excellent and slackcountry late season skiing is possible. Space is clean and has wonderful amenities the deck is a stand out for quiet mornings in nature. Saddleback is truly a four season destination and this is a great spot to enjoy it.

name: Ward
review: Great place, great host!  Ryan is a gem.  We were going to see the eclipse and needed to arrive earlier than 4 pm to avoid traffic and be in place when the eclipse started at 2:30.  He accommodated us and was very helpful.  The condo itself is beautiful and it has a lot of style.  The view was fabulous, and the bed in the primary bedroom downstairs had a wonderfully firm mattress on a huge bed.  The kitchen was well-appointed, including an ice machine.    Ryan was very responsive to my questions and did a great job of making us feel welcome.   The five of us enjoyed our one day here and wished we could have stayed longer.

name: Mary
review: Incredible stay here at Saddleback. This condo is beautiful with an amazing view of the lake. It’s not busy at Saddleback this time of year so with virtually no one around there is such a sense of peace and tranquility. Ryan was able to host us on very short notice and was very responsive to make sure everything went well on our arrival. I can’t wait to come back and enjoy this feeling again!

name: Deborah
review: We had a truly wonderful stay at Ryan's beautiful ski-in/ski-out condo! It's clean and very comfortable and the views are outstanding! The kitchen had all we needed to prepare our meals and we relaxed in the evenings by the fireplace and enjoyed the large TV screen in the living room. Ryan's communication was excellent for any questions we had during our stay. It's a short ride into Rangeley for groceries at the IGA and they had everything we needed. We loved our ski days at Saddleback and the staff there was friendly and the atmosphere in the lodge was welcoming and comfortable. We would absolutely recommend staying at Ryan's and we look forward to coming back for another ski trip!

name: Liza
review: This condo is beautiful, the view is the most amazing view you can get without hiking a mountain.  Every night the sunset was gorgeous.  Ryan responded immediately to all postings/questions.  I have stayed with airbnb several times and never had a host respond so quickly.  Just know that this condo is about 15-20 min outside of Rangeley town so know you will be driving up/down the mountain for any outings.  The bonus to that is it is extremely peaceful with few people around (we stayed in June).  You should definitely stay here!

name: Wendy
review: Ryan’s condo is wonderful-another reviewer said it perfectly when they said something along the lines of the view being a “gut punch” every time you see it. And you see it from the living area and also the master bedroom. Waking up to that as you are still lying in bed is amazing! I have been coming to Rangeley for 50 years and this was one of the most comfortable, stunning places I have stayed. The bed was super comfortable, the kitchen had what we needed to do a bit of cooking, the place was clean and looked pretty new. But I also appreciated that it felt like Maine with all the decorations and of course, the view. I highly recommend Ryan’s place and hope to come back!

name: Michelle
review: Beautiful location, beautifully furnished! Radiant floor heat in the lower level was a welcome surprise and special treat. There was enough room for everyone in our group to spread out and relax. We spent one day at the nearby, very welcoming Rangeley Trails Center for xc skiing and snowshoeing, and one day enjoying downhill skiing at Sugarloaf.  A great time was had by all!

name: Jennifer
review:
The couch appeared new which was great, the views were incredible!
Not a fan of carpeting in rentals but other than that it was a gorgeous unit and my kids loved the bunk beds. 
Of note, 2 windows were boarded up downstairs. 
We loved our stay, would definitely stay here again!

name: Robin
review: This condo has a fantastic view, has comfortable beds and living spaces and a fully functional kitchen. As with any rural location, the Internet is slow, but OK. We had a good time during our weekend stay.

name: Lacey
review: Had a great stay at Ryan’s, it was actually bigger than it looked in the photos. Beautiful view from the deck, very quiet right now because it’s summer at a ski resort but that’s exactly what I wanted. There is no AC but the downstairs was very cool. I would love to come back in the winter!

name: Mike
review:
This place is a peak Maine vacation spot on Saddleback Mountain. We enjoyed the amazing views and comfy couches after our long ski days at nearby Sugarloaf. Ryan is also a great host and everything was a breeze. 
We would definitely return here next Maine vacation!

name: Zac
review:
Beautiful space right on the mountain. Gorgeous sunrise and sunset views were captured right from the deck. We rented it to be able to skin and ski while the mountain is closed. We were able to leave and return on our skis right to the door in April! 
Ryan was easy to contact and helpful when we had trouble with GPS directions.  The house was stocked with everything we needed. 
I would recommend to anyone and will likely rebook for our trip again next year!

name: Kathryn
review: Ryan’s place was absolutely fantastic. Great value, great views, great communication. We were able to check in earlier than we had hoped for and when I asked for recommendations for somewhere to eat, he went above and beyond and gave many choices. Honestly I couldn’t have asked for a better host. My husband and I only got to stay one night but definitely will be coming back. Absolutely worth every penny.

name: Deb
review: My family stayed at Ryan's condo for some much needed R&R.  We were pleased with how comfortable and clean it was.  It is very nicely furnished.  And the view of the mountains is stunningly gorgeous!  Ryan was always quick to respond to my messages, and was so friendly and helpful.  We have stayed in Rangeley before, but this was our first time staying at Ryan's condo - our favorite accommodations by far! Hoping to return this summer or fall.

name: Tiffany
review: This is the perfect place to relax and unwind. I chose this place for the amazing view and fireplace. I was determined to stay somewhere with beautiful fall foliage 🍂 While I was there it snowed for a bit and provided a majestic atmosphere. I thoroughly enjoyed both fall and a mini winter ❄️  The townhome is really cozy and even though there are townhomes around, it feels very private and peaceful. It’s very clean and I felt right at home.  I hope to be back again.

name: Chris & Naomi
review:
This was perfect for our family (2 adults, 4 kids). There was plenty of space for everyone to be comfortable and the older kids were able to go off on their own since the trails were quite close. 
The house is itself was cozy and well furnished. The views were spectacular and very peaceful. 
We had a small issue when trying to check in, but within minutes got a response from the host, who immediately solved the problem.
Overall, we were very happy with our stay and will be returning for sure!

name: Erin
review: What a gorgeous location! We enjoyed the panoramic views of the mountaintops from above the clouds. The condo was plenty spacious for our four adults and three kids. We had fun playing games at the large dining table. Beds were comfortable and the place was clean and as described in the listing. Owner is very responsive. If the occasion calls for us to visit the area again, we’d definitely stay here.

name: Eric
review:
Absolutely beautiful place with an absolutely amazing view! Ryan was extremely responsive through out the process whenever we had questions.
Very tasteful decor in the home that gives it a fun vibe.
One of our favorite things to do was to sit on the balcony watching the sunsets over the valley.  Very nice!

name: Ian
review:
Amazing place! Perfect location for utilizing Saddleback. Mountain is currently closed down but that makes it even better - no one to compete with for fresh lines! 4 of us used Ryan's place as a base camp for touring all over Saddleback. Incredible summit views and snow conditions. Will definitely be back.
Ryan was also very helpful when we had a slight issue checking in: the lockbox that has the keys can sometimes get a bit frozen / stuck. We ending up using a knife to help pry it open the first time we arrived. Other than that everything was great. Huge place for the price. Full kitchen, fireplace for the ski boots, comfy couches and beds, not sure what else you need!

name: Joyce
review:
Amazing property, Perfect location! 
I’m sure most of the interest in this mountainside chalet is for winter skiing, but I booked this to introduce my Midwest husband to the best summer hiking in my home state. He was NOT disappointed. 
First off, the view is an immediate gut punch. There is nothing like the western mountains of Maine, and this chalet serves it up on a platter! 
Ryan provides WiFi (thanks Ryan!), so my husband would work for a few hours in the morning, set up in the dining room that easily seats 10, with that view in front of him. Meantime, I took our our dog for a walk (Ryan likes well behaved dogs. Place is dog friendly!) on the side trails picking wild mountain raspberries. (These do not grow on typical bushes. They are very low to the ground, so keep your eyes peeled in the summer and watch where you walk on a hike up the mountain.)
Saddleback Mt. is actually 3 peaks: Saddleback, Saddleback the Horn, and Saddleback Jr. The mountain as a whole is on the 4K Peakbagger list, with 2 of the peaks listed in the top 14. The AT (Appalachian Trail) traverses all 3 peaks. There is no better hiking with the best reward in all of Western Maine than the 3 peaks of Saddleback. Stay here and you get to hike in - hike out, and then hit the base lodge for dinner, or cook in your own well-appointed kitchen. 
So, specifics about the chalet… It’s a duplex, but very quiet. There are ski trails leading directly to your door, the same trails that you can climb in the summer to the top of the mountain and hike part of the AT. There is plenty of parking and lots of outdoor space dedicated to this property. There’s a deck and lower level patio, and every view is just wicked. 
The chalet has a main floor and lower level, both with tons of space. 
The main floor has the kitchen stocked with all of the cookware you’ll need, large dining room, great room, and a bedroom with a very comfortable queen bed and full bath. The dining room and great room has cathedral ceilings and a wall of windows and slider to the deck.  My husband liked the sound system in the great room. 
The lower level features another full bath, a HUGE bedroom with a gorgeous and comfortable king bed and a wall of windows for that wicked view.  Another good sized bedroom with a twin-over-full bunk and huge windows.  There’s a full-size HE stacked washer and dryer in the utility room, and a great theater room with a comfy L-sofa and a massive bean bag. 
I really liked that if you had a couple vacationing with you that didn’t want stairs to get to their bedroom, the main floor has a very comfortable queen suitable for them. 
Here are the things that probably only I would notice, because I’m geeky like that:  The quality Anderson casement windows. Grow up in western Maine and you learn to expect a little sass with a winter storm. Sometimes you’ll get pelted with ice before your gift of 3’ of snow. You’ll be comfortable in the middle of winter here between the fireplace and the Anderson casement windows. 
I can’t say enough glowing things about this property, so I’ll just beg future guests to PLEASE respect this property. I hope Ryan keeps it on the rental market for a long time so I can visit home in style and comfort.

name: Bailey
review:
Highly recommend this place! My husband and I came with another couple during labor day weekend, and we all had a great time! Perfect location if you would like to hike some 4,000 footers- Saddleback & The Horn. Lots of great fishing and kayaking spots nearby. Only 15 minutes from Rangeley where you can shop and eat out. Ryan was very helpful in giving us suggestions for places to go! The place was super clean, the bed in the master suite was very comfortable, and the views were spectacular! 
Can’t wait to come back again soon!

name: Rafi
review: We stayed here for a few nights in October and had a great time. The condo was spacious and comfortable for all of us and had all the basics you typically need. There’s a supermarket in town for anything else. The views from the balcony were amazing and I would definitely go back for that alone.

name: Amanda
review: This was a wonderful place to stay, I was happy with the photos on the listening but I think it hard even more charm in person. Very clean and well taken care of with easy instructions for everything you will need to know. Would absolutely stay here again!

name: Nichole
review: House and area are gorgeous! I know we stayed in the off season for the location, but house could have been a little cleaner. Dirty pimple patch on the bathroom counter and a pair of men’s underwear and some receipts in a dresser drawer. Otherwise no issues and had a great stay! Kitchen is supplied nicely and beds were clean and comfortable. Would definitely stay again!

name: Alex
review: Fantastic property! Gorgeous views, well-appointed condo. Communication was top-notch…host was able to facilitate an early check-in, as well as resolving a minor issue in <15 min. 10/10 would stay again.

name: Arden
review: We had a great stay at Saddleback! We hiked Tumbledown mountain and then had a relaxing night at the condo with breathtaking views! Our host was very responsive and helpful with questions. Great stay!

name: Michelle
review:
Ryan was very helpful, pleasant and quick to respond to all our inquiries. 
The condo was just what we needed for the night, with an amazing view. Unfortunately, we didn’t get to enjoy the condo for long, it was a quick one night stay…hope to return and spend a couple of days there. 
I recommend staying at his place if you are in the area.

name: Daniel
review:
Overall, great experience! Beautiful location, clean, lots of space. Only concern was that the page stated I should get an email from Yale Locks when the code was actually in the initial message sent when the booking was confirmed. Partially my fault, but partially unclear in the direction department. 
Would definitely stay again.

name: Cynthia
review: What a beautiful, clean, relaxed, well-organized home in a spectacular setting! We enjoyed discovering a trail to two ponds and two overlooks, as well as hiking up the mountain. Watching the sunset from the deck was incredible. Rangeley has a good grocery store and interesting shops and restaurants to investigate, but we loved just hanging out in the condo and hiking. Perfect!

name: Scott
review:
I was looking to plan a last-minute fall trip north before starting a new job and stumbled upon Ryan's listing. Took a shot and I could not be happier with my decision to stay here! The condo was beautiful and the views were absolutely amazing! Being dog-friendly was a huge plus so I didn't need to find someone to watch my four-legged family member. 
There are hiking trails accessible from the front door and the town is a short drive down the mountain. This trip was SO relaxing and exactly what I needed! 
I'm not much of a skier but I can see this place being the perfect place to stay & ski. I may get back into skiing just to stay at Ryan's place again!

name: Jess
review: It’s clean, perfect for the whole family. Some of the window’s nets have holes in them so the mosquitoes might get in.. the view is spectacular! The location was too rural for our liking though, nothing really to do in town. Wifi will lag if more than 3 phones are using it. Overall a nice place, what would make it better is it had a grill on the deck and more tables/portable chairs.

name: Vance
review: Ryan’s house is an amazing place to stay. Awesome views and good amenities. Beds are comfortable and everything is very clean. Communication with Ryan was easy and quick.

name: Eliza
review: Amazing stay! Thanks so much! Beautiful views, near so many activities, and the perfect amount of space. Kitchen was super well equipped and everything was really clean. Ryan was helpful and responded to all communication quickly!

name: Divy
review:
Well organized, clean house with good utilities inside. A little bit hard to reach to the place specially in the night as the Google/Apple maps won't find this location directly, have to read the signs and look around for the first time but then it's okay. 
Great view from the apartment and the rooms and utilities are the same as shown in the posted images. Highly recommend this place!

name: Laura
review: Awesome place for a group of friends or two small families to spend a winter getaway! Fat biking, cross-country skiing, or hike up the (closed) Saddleback ski trails. Comfy beds, great views, well equipped kitchen (we brought all our food with us rather than drive into town). The wifi broke just before we got there, but Ryan was an excellent communicator and let us know in advance, and even took a bit off the price. The access road was well-plowed (although we have snow tires). Great stay!

name: Christy
review: We loved staying here! So gorgeous and clean! We actually did not see the large trash dumpsters indicated in the instructions so had to throw our trash away at the gas station but we honestly didn’t look that hard- it just wasn’t super obvious so we kept going. Overall an amazing stay, would definitely recommend this place to others!

name: Lynn
review: This condo was clean and super comfy for my family of 5.  We were very happy with the proximity to skiing and the ease in which we could actually ski out, back in for lunch and right back out again! Definitely a luxury we are not used to.  Host was also very responsive when we reached out with questions.

name: Ashley
review: Will definitely be booking back soon at Ryan’s place. It was absolutely breathtaking with the views! The inside of the home was gorgeous. Even tho we booked at the last minute and didn’t get up there until late evening- Ryan was so responsive within minutes for the initial booking- sending messages- etc. Overall he was all around very friendly! You will not be disappointed at all. I highly recommend this stay as you WILL NOT be disappointed at all. We woke up early morning just to wake up to watch the beautiful sunrise on the patio from the living room. The house was spotless! Will definitely be back VERY soon. Thank you so very much Ryan!!!

name: Trevor
review: Ryan’s place was great! Beautiful views, right on the mountain for skiing, comfortable condo. Ryan was easy to communicate with and very accommodating. We would stay here again!

name: Marshall
review: Ryan was very quick to respond with any questions, the condo had a beautiful view from the back deck and close to downtown Rangeley. It was a great fall get away.

name: Lindsey
review: Ryan's place for was great! Very comfy and cozy with amazing views. We came to do some hiking/trail running and loved that we could just walk out the door, up the super steep ski route, and be on trails. Ryan's place had everything we needed (but nothing extra- bring your own coffee!). We loved our stay and hope to be back with friends soon.

name: Andrae
review: Really lovely place to stay and had no issues with check in. Everything was super easy! Very clean and spacious and loved staying here this summer.

name: Laura
review:
We had a great stay at Ryan’s place. Sitting at the kitchen table enjoying coffee in the morning and looking at that view was
Incredible! Cozy furniture, a big screen TV, wonderful high top on the deck where we sat and relaxed and comfortable beds…everything was great! Directions from Ryan were perfect and we had zero trouble getting in to the condo. Thanks, Ryan!

name: Rebecca
review: We loved staying here! Plenty of space, gorgeous views, easy to access the mountain, warm gas fireplace. We really appreciated the boot dryer too. I would suggest skiing down the groomed path and the end of the road and going to the lodge/lifts-just a bit of skating. Another reviewer suggested a short uphill walk  and that was MISERABLE with children.

name: Rita
review: The condo was perfect for our trip to Rangeley.  It is spacious and well maintained.  The views from the condo were spectacular.  Our hosts were most accommodating and responsive.

name: Denah
review: The place was exactly as described and very clean.  Staying here was a very relaxing get away with beautiful views of the mountains and Rangley lake. If you like to snow ski or snow board, it's a perfect location.  I would definetly stay here again.

name: Deborah
review: This home was so cozy and beautiful, the views were GORGEOUS, and I couldn't have asked for a better combination. Ryan is very quick to respond and very easy to work with. Thank you, thank you, thank you! I will definitely be a repeat visitor!

name: Pippi
review: Great place to stay to watch the sunset. Awesome balcony with a great view of Rangeley. Clean and cozy and Ryan was very responsive and directions were clear to get to the place. Would definitely stay there again

name: Tina
review: Ryan’s condo was clean had comfortable beds and the kitchen was stocked with good quality pots pans dishes and utensils.  There were two couples that stayed for the weekend.  The condo was perfect for us because each level had its own bedroom and bath!  My favorite part of staying at this condo is the stargazing at night and the amazing view!

name: Erica
review: Amazing stay! Ryan is very responsive & a great host. The condo was just as pictured. Very clean and spacious. The view is unbelievable. We will definitely stay here again. Everything was just perfect!

name: Bree
review: Ryan’s place was wonderful in every way and we had a blast. Comfortable, quiet, gorgeous views and just fantastic. Loved that most of the bedrooms are downstairs so they don’t get over heated after an evening cozying by the fireplace: brilliant! Had everything we needed- love that there was a front-loading washing machine for washing clothes as needed. Beds were nice and comfortable and nice towels and wash cloths. Would stay here again in a heartbeat! Found the easiest access back to the condo was just skiing straight down blue devil and staying straight onto the cat track, keep your speed and go left. Also for skiing out in the morning: at the end of the parking lot, rather than follow the cat track down and to left, hike up maybe 10-20 feet and there there is a nice sneak through the woods that saves skating back uphill.

name: Michelle
review: This was our third stay at Ryan's condo. We absolutely love it here and would come up every weekend/month if we could. Everything is beautiful, from the quality construction to the views. We will be back as soon as it's not completely booked!

name: Erin
review: I would highly recommend staying at Ryan’s place. It is immaculate, tasteful, and super comfortable. Ryan is also a wonderful and easygoing host. I would absolutely stay here again!

name: Nicholas
review: Great value, Ryan was very accommodating and responds quickly to text and emails answering all questions. The pictures don't do the house justice. It's beautiful and the view of saddleback valley is even better. If saddleback isn't on your list this season it needs to be next season.

name: Jennifer
review: The best value! Our family loved this condo and enjoyed a wonderful time over there. I personally appreciate Ryan's quick response and helpful tips! Easy access to all the activities: hiking, boating, fishing, and local restaurants! Amazing view of sunset and sunrise from our own bedroom windows. Highly recommend this place.

name: Ellen
review: This condo had everything we wanted, and nothing we didn’t: clean spaces, comfy beds, warm heat and gas fireplace on a cold week, and an absolutely insane view. Plus, the ski trail is about 15 feet from the front step. We booked for next year before we left.

name: Matthew
review: My wife and I truly enjoyed our time at Ryan’s place. Ryan was responsive and helpful in communicating with us. The apartment was clean, cozy, and comfortable. The highlight for us was the spectacular view of the mountains and Rangeley Lakes from the back deck—especially at sunset. We highly recommend it!

name: Theresa
review: We had a wonderful stay at Ryan's place!  The unit was as promised and the view was amazing.  We will definitely stay again!

name: Carla
review: Amazing spot.  Beautiful views even if you aren’t on the slopes. Ski in/ski out was perfect, parking was a breeze and the place had everything you need for a night in with a group. Very clean and Ryan was super responsive.

name: Felicia
review: We had a great stay over Christmas with our three kids. We love skiing at Saddleback and being located on the mountain made for easy access and two full days on the slopes. The condo was clean, and had plenty of space for all of us.

name: Shelby
review: My Husband & I booked Ryan's place later in the day, which he responded with the confirmation of booking. Very quickly, I might add. Once we entered, everything looked exactly like the pictures. Location was great on top of Saddleback mountain.  The views were incredible. Home is close to Rangeley. I can not say anything bad about this place. Thanks again Ryan.

name: Lauren
review: Such an amazing location and the view is incredible! All of the comforts of home and everything we needed. Ryan was fast at responding to messages and available if we needed anything. We look forward to visiting again next year!

name: Beccah
review: Booked within just a few days, decent rates and fast communication. Booked for my sister and parents to stay after my wedding. They said it was great and the view was beautiful.

name: Erik
review: There was a slight issue with check in but Ryan was quick to communicate and resolve our dilemma. The place was very clean, plenty of room, and had a great view. Thanks for having us. We would definitely recommend this location.

name: Tony
review: These are great places to stay.  Clean and well appointed.  Not close to town but nice and quiet and very comfortable.

name: David
review: The mountainside condo was ideal for ski in/out. The views and sunset were absolutely amazing. We would stay here again.

name: Jake
review: Awesome place with amazing views. Ryan was very responsive to any questions we had before/during stay. Amazing place in a great little town with lots to do. Would definitely return!

name: Rosemary
review:
I loved staying at Ryan’s condo. I felt at home when I walked in. Everything was squeaky clean. The view was absolutely beautiful. A real plus was that I could bring my dog. 
I would return in a heartbeat.

name: Ran
review: Ryan’s place was spectacular. The view from the deck was amazing looking out over Rangeley. The place itself was spacious, clean, and ready for us as guests. We super appreciated Ryan’s easy communication and enjoyed the place thoroughly while we stayed.

name: Ashley
review: Beautiful views, great amenities, and a fantastic location for any season! And lots of space! We only had a short one night stay to do some leaf peeping in the fall, and this was a perfect spot to do so. Hope to stay here again in the winter sometime and cozy up by the fireplace and do some skiing.

name: Benjamin
review:
Wonderful mountain side condo with amazing views and great amenities.
WiFi, nice kitchen, plenty of room - two large bedrooms and a kids room with bunk beds , large eating area.
Highly recommended!

name: Megan
review: The condo is huge and clean. The views are incredible. While the ski resort may not be open, it's a great area to hike around and is an easy drive to Sugarloaf. The town of Rangeley has a lot of great restaurants and had more than I was expecting. Ryan was helpful and easy to communicate with. I highly recommend this condo!

name: Nikki
review: Great place to stay! Very clean and lots of space for the group of us. We stayed here for a wedding near by but would return again during ski season. Overall great place and Ryan is quick to respond with any questions we had.

name: David
review: What a view! If we didn't plan on hiking Saddleback Mountain, we would have just lounged on the deck overlooking Rangeley Lake. Location was perfect for us; the start of the trail was 5 minutes away (drive) and town center 15 minutes away. Place is very clean and comfy. Ryan is a great host - super friendly and very responsive.

name: Ainsley
review: Despite the weather not cooperating for skiing, Ryan’s place saved the vacation! It is a beautiful condo and location, felt very comfortable and homey, easy access to the mountain, absolutely perfect for three couples and our toddlers - never felt overly cramped even though we had to be stuck inside more than expected!

name: Rebecca
review: Loved our stay at the condo. So comfortable, clean, beautiful view and great location.

name: Natalie
review: We only stayed here one night while passing through but it was very comfortable and had everything we needed. Amazing view and Ryan was very responsive.

name: Michelle
review: We love Ryan’s place. This was our second visit: it’s gorgeous, cozy, comfy, and spacious, with room for everyone to spread out or gather together. Ryan is great to work with. The area is absolutely beautiful and everyone you encounter is friendly and happy to be there.

name: Robin
review: This condo is a great place to get away and enjoy the peace and quiet of Maine. Myself and a few friend drove up from NH, to backcountry ski. The condo is slope side, with great ski in, ski out access. The condo is cozy, clean and warm. It was also nice that we were able to bring our dogs. Not many places allow fur friends. I highly recommend!

name: Rebecca
review: Fantastic lodging with great views, great host and all around wonderful experience! This was our first experience with an Air BNB rental and it was exactly what we were looking for...We would stay again in a heartbeat!

name: Diane
review:
What an incredible spot! The views will take your breath away. Only got to stay here one night but am hoping to be back.
Well equipped - down to coffee filters and olive oil! Nice surprise. Communication was great as well.

name: Joe
review: Our family stayed at Ryan’s place for a weekend getaway. The view is truly outstanding, and there is plenty of room to spread out. Beds were very comfortable. We hiked up Saddleback Mountain right from the condo. It’s a beautiful 15 minute drive from town. Would definitely stay again.

name: Carolyn
review: An absolutely lovely place to stay. Comfortably sleeps 7-8, beautiful sunrise view, nice and close to quaint Rangeley, with quick access to many lakes and lots of wilderness.

name: Kate
review: Great for a family get away - we were there in the spring. Beautiful location with easy access to wonderful hiking trails and downtown Rangeley. Our kids loved it too! Ryan was very responsive and helpful.

name: Megan
review: Beautiful spot. Cozy, amazing views. Perfect getaway. Easy to check in and out. This was my first Airbnb, and I'm very impressed!

name: Jena And James
review:
This place was perfect for our Memorial Day weekend getaway. We were 4 adults and 2 kids and had plenty of space for all of us. The house is clean and comfortable, and like the other reviews mentioned: the views are stunning. We especially loved the sunsets. The kitchen was stocked with what we needed to cook all of our meals together, and we enjoyed playing the board games that were provided. 
Ryan was responsive and so welcoming. We feel so grateful to have found this place and hope for another future opportunity to return. 
Some highlights of the area:
Hiking a 3 mile portion of the Appalachian trail to Piazza Rock (get there before 9:30a for parking and bring bug spray!)
Driving up to Quill Hill for stunning views and a really sweet story about the man who built this road to share with others (www.quillhillMaine.com)
Bowling and food at Moose Alley (be sure to make reservations for a lane)
Eating pizza outside at the Furbish Brew House + Eats. 
Browsing the book collection at Books, Lines, and Thinkers and meeting the store owner who is so passionate about books and has his own table of personal book recommendations.

name: After The Fall Farm- Maia And Jacob
review: Ryan’s place was great- super clean, beautiful views of the lake and the mountains and very spacious ! It was perfect for our needs and we will definitely return.

name: Caroline
review: Perfect location for hike up Saddleback and to the horn.  Easy access to AT.  Beds were super comfortable.   Bring all the condiments you might need.  Only salt and pepper in the cupboards.  Except for morning Keurig which was lovely!

name: Graeme
review: This is a really beautiful spot, right near the top of the mountain. Perfect for snow sports enthusiasts. There are also beautiful walks nearby, and the town is not too far. The kitchen had most of the basics, and we were able to cook fairly easily. The views are incredible from the living / dining room.

name: Matt
review: Great space in a great location - beautiful views!  And Ryan was quick to respond to our emails - very helpful.

name: Jovan
review: This place is a gem! If you can, get a reservation book it immediately. The condo is spacious and very close to the trail! The kitchen was wonderful to cook meals and stay in, instead of going out. My family can't wait to return! Ryan was prompt to answer any questions I had and made our vacation seamless. He truly is a super host!

name: Beth
review: Super clean place. Lots of space - bedrooms are a great size and the beds comfortable. All the comforts of home provided by Ryan - bedding, towels, soap, toilet tissue, cooking utensils, etc! You only need to bring your ski or hiking stuff! Gas fireplace is a nice touch too.

name: Dave
review: Great condo in a gorgeous setting. Condo has everything a small or big group would need for a relaxing stay. We went during fall foliage season, but I'd imagine this place is nice all year round!

name: David
review: Great value, like new property with astounding views. Pointed out a couple of maintenance items that Ryan said he would jump right on. Would stay again in a heartbeat.

name: Kourtney
review: Ryan was pleasant to communicate with, the view was stunning, and the residence was in really good condition. I would absolutely come back if I were to ever travel here again!

name: Alison
review: Lovely condo on the mountain. Spacious and comfortable with the most amazing views of the lake. Well equipped kitchen and great eating area. The master bed was incredibly comfortable. Highly recommend!

name: Martha
review: What a great location with fabulous views of the rangeley lakes from saddleback mountain.  We were thrilled we could bring our lab and she enjoyed the easy access to the ski trails (unfortunately my still closed) we had some epic snowshoe hikes up the mt and enjoyed seeing the weekend warriors skinning up and skiing down.  Everything was top notch and Ryan helped solve a cable tv issue.  We hope to go again next year...great spot even though saddleback isn’t open.  Rangeley trails cross country ski area is top notch and only minutes away.

name: Caitlin
review: Had the best time at this condo! The king bed is comfy and the kids loved the bunk beds. Super easy ski in/ski out. Very clean and functional. Ryan is an excellent host!

name: Ellis
review: We loved our stay. Gorgeous view! Comfortable and clean ski condo. And easy access to the mountain. We will definitely be back!!

name: Jeff
review: Came up with my wife, brother, and parents and had a great stay. Ryan was super responsive and helpful arranging check in. The space is big enough to spread out and really well kept. The view was amazing. Highly recommend!

name: Crystal
review: This is a great place especially for those interested in hiking without having to drive  anywhere. Took advantage of a few different hikes including to the top of saddleback which only requires walking out the door! Close enough for quick drives into town, but also far enough away for peace and quiet and the view is wonderful for early morning coffees on the deck, or a late night drink. Definitely looking forward to booking again!!

name: Amanda
review: This condo is absolutely incredible for the price. Beautiful views, super clean and comfortable! We’ll be back!

name: Sean
review: Beautiful view. Clear and simple instructions for check in and check out. Solid value. Would definitely stay again!

name: Jenn
review: An amazing place with out-the-door access to Saddleback - got great hikes in both days that we stayed. Very comfortable place to come back to!

name: Nicole
review: Ryan has a beautiful spot with stunning views. The apartment is spacious and the beds are very comfortable. We stayed here on our way from Boston to Québec and it was a wonderful night stay. It was secluded and peaceful.

name: Gabriel
review: Everything was great, the house is beautiful and well kept, the view is gorgeous. A truly comfy ski in/out for a family trip do saddleback mountain, we felt at home.

name: Rachel
review: This place was amazing. The views from the deck, phenomenal. So much space and the bed that I slept in upstairs was so comfy, I could've died happy in it. I'm not a skier, but I stayed there to hike up Saddleback Mountain and the trailhead is right there. If you're a skier, then the ski lift and lodge and all of that is right there as well.

name: Matt
review: Place was very clean and had an amazing view. Ryan answered any questions regardless of time within minutes. Condo is great, just as described. Would stay again when back in Rangeley visiting for sure!!

name: Sarah
review: We had a fabulous stay at Saddleback Mountain! Ryan's condo was perfect for your family getaway with plenty of room, fabulous amenities and a beautiful view of Rangley! We loved it and hope to be back again next year! Thank you Ryan!

name: Susan
review: A fabulous stay from start to Finnish!  Ryan's home is located high up and has the most amazing views, cool breezes and peace!  super clean and has everything needed for a couple days or longer stay.  Highly recommended!

name: Mari
review: The view is worth every penny! My family had a great time. The home is ideally located and near conveniences. Ryan’s has great communication, very prompt and courteous. Would return again.

name: Nate
review: Ryan's place was very comfortable and had everything we needed to have a relaxing and memorable stay in Rangeley. The views from the upstairs porch were incredible!

name: Dylan
review: The AirBNB was spacious, clean and offered magnificent views of the surrounding mountains and lakes. Ryan was great to work with and easy to communicate with. Thanks so much.

name: Mathew
review:
Beautiful home with amazing views. I cannot imagine a time of year where the view from the house is not stunning. 
Due to the mountain being closed to skiing operations it makes the former bustling resort and nice private location. While I hope they reopen the resort, but in the mean time it is still a great way to enjoy amazing condos in the Rangeley region with some piece and quiet.

name: Louis
review: Ryan’s townhome is a home away from home. Incredibly comfortable and has everything you could need. Unfortunately Saaddleback mountain was still closed during our stay (3 years now closed) but it was such a nice place we still had a very nice vacation. Amazing morning views with breakfast. We are plannng on remodeling our home and now thinking of copying Ryan’s place it was so comfortable! Ryan also responds to questions very quickly.

name: Eve
review: This home has a magnificent view- it was a delight to enjoy during our stay. The house was clean and comfortable. Or only complaint is that the mattresses on the bunk bed are VERY squeeky- so not great if there are 2 kids trying to sleep in there :)

name: Ramon
review:
Just as described - Beautiful place, very spacious, and very homely.
Ryan was very responsive and helpful. Would definitely visit again!

name: Danny
review: We came up to Saddleback for a quiet weekend getaway and it was perfect.  Ryan's place was easy to access, had beautiful views, and was everything described.

name: Julie
review: We went to Rangeley for a family reunion. Part of the reason we chose Ryan’s place was the generous cancellation policy. Didn’t know if my 95 year old father would be up to it.  Thankfully he was! The condo was perfect for our needs. It was very clean with a beautiful view. Overall a very nice place to stay. Would love to go back in the ski season.

name: Natalie-Francesca
review: This was truly a wonderful stay complete with stunning views outside and a very cozy feel within. The chalet is spacious, updated ,and is situated in a beautiful location - we wish we stayed longer!

name: Colin
review: Ryan's condo is a cosy and comfortable hideout, with a spectacular view.  The x-country ski center is just down the road, with many miles of groomed trails.  All was as advertised and shown in the photos.  Check-in was straightforward, and Ryan was quick to respond to our messages.

name: Patrick
review: My family loved skiing at Saddleback and this condo was the perfect way to experience it. Ryan was very responsive and helpful with any questions we had during our stay. Would definitely come back.

name: Todd
review: This place is amazing! Beautuful views, very clean and close to everything, all for a very great rate! Will definitely be back!

name: Brian
review: A perfect spot for ski-in, ski-out access to the amazing Saddleback Ski Area. The Condo suited the needs of our picky family without exception. Ryan lives up to his Superhost label --- amazingly responsive and friendly!

name: Palak
review:
Good place to stay with Amazing sunset view from the Airbnb. Perfect place to get away from the city. Amazing ski resort nearby and this location is really nice place for star gazing at night. 
I loved the food in this region. I found really nice Cafes, Bakeries and restaurants in this region. 
Great stay. :)

name: Blake
review: This place leaves nothing to be desired.  Tons of space, clean, up to date, and easy access.  Definitely a hidden gem in Rangeley, considering that the mountain is closed.

name: Molly
review: Ryan’s beautiful condo is a true gem! Sweeping mountain vistas out of every window, sparkling clean accommodations, and a super friendly and responsive host made for a dream getaway. As if all this weren’t enough, the condo is only minutes away from a gorgeous outdoor center where you can cross country ski, snow shoe etc (and that’s just in winter!). There are hikes out your back door and the town of Rangeley had plenty to offer - our favorites were The Shed and the Rangeley Tavern. We used the condo as a base for skiing Sugarloaf, which is an hour away, but a beautiful drive and we will definitely do it again!!

name: Christina
review: This place is fantastic! My family had a wonderful time. The skiing was great and the location is perfect!

name: Erica
review: Condo is beautiful. Perfectly clean. Host communicated quickly to questions. Would absolutely stay again.

name: Beth
review: Ryan’s chalet is a dream. The view is phenomenal and the location is close to numerous outdoor activities. I felt right at home in the cozy and comfortable space. I will definitely be back in the future!

name: Jarron
review: Amazing views. Clean, comfortable and accommodating. A+

name: Evan
review: The house was great and slept all that it said it would. View was great too. Nice appliances as well.

name: Will
review: Great place.  We had a great time with no issues.  We would love to be back in the future.

name: Jackie
review: If you have a chance to stay here, please do! This condo is so cozy, has a fireplace, lovely views and is a great place to stay if you’re hitting the mountains. While saddleback was closed, we hit sugarloaf which is only about 45 min away. Ryan responds so quickly to all questions and was super flexible as he let us have a late check out and also worked around a date change during the booking process. Thanks Ryan!!

name: Kimberly
review: Beautiful views in a comfortable place! Ryan was attentive to any questions we had. We look forward to another stay next year!

name: Rita
review: This was our first Airbnb experience and it certainly surpassed our expectations! Ryan’s place is absolutely wonderful. Great location, wonderful amenities. Highly recommend!

name: Tyler
review: Great condo with the best views around. Awesome place for a night away.

name: Patrick
review: Was a wonderful view there on the porch. The place was way up on top and was very quiet. Was able to see a lot of wildlife not only going up there but looking above where we were. Would recommend this place with out a doubt.

name: Tricia
review: Beautiful, comfortable condo with a very responsive owner, Ryan.  Felt like home.  I didn't want to leave!

name: Ryan
review: The view from the patio was great, the pictures really don’t do it justice. The kitchen had everything we needed to make meals at the home.

name: Maria
review: My guests and I had an amazing experience at Ryan’s place. The views are incredible,  and the location was exactly what we were looking for. Peaceful atmosphere and breathtaking sunrises and sunsets spectacular right off his porch. I definitely recommend  it.

name: Denise
review: The views are stunning! We had the most amazing sunset right off the back deck! Ryan's place was comfortable, and well equipped. We had a little trouble locating our unit initially but, Ryan was very responsive, incredibly helpful, and had us squared away within minutes. Highly recommend.

name: Sherry
review: Beautiful location, clean and nicely  decorated chalet. Had everything we needed for a comfortable stay.

name: Ingrid
review: We loved Ryan’s chalet! It is beautifully decorated, spacious and very comfortable. The views are amazing. We would definitely return! Ryan is a very responsive, excellent host.

name: Cheryl
review: Ryan was awesome! Very responsive to any questions. The place was fully equipped and beautiful!

name: Susan
review: Ryan’s condo on the slopes of Saddleback Mountain was super clean, comfortable, and a perfect spot for my entire family including our  dog to snowshoe/ ski/ snowboard on Saddleback and at Sugarloaf. We look forward to renting again in the future. Thanks, Ryan!

name: Natalie
review: Beautiful and peaceful place to stay. We really enjoyed the views. Ryan was a great host and easy to communicate with. Thank you!

name: Aleky
review: This place was beautiful, spotless and cozy. Ryan was super friendly and helpful.

name: Alexandre
review: We ended staying at the unit next door. Incredible place and surrounding. Ryan was so helpful and responsive. We highly recommend!

name: Randy
review: We stayed here for a friend’s weekend and it was absolutely gorgeous. The condo it’s just perfect. We already plan to stay again as soon as possible!! 100% recommend to everyone.

name: Brenda
review: We only stayed 1 night, but it was a wonderful place. The view was awesome. Very clean and wonderfully decorated.  I would recommend definitely.

name: David
review: Ryan’s place is great. It was very clean and had excellent views. We will definitely be back!

name: Cassie
review: Gorgeous views, clean, comfortable,spacious, right next to a path where we could just grab our skis and ski on down to the chairlift and at the end of the day ski right on down to the condo again.

name: Isaah
review: Ryan was excellent to work with and was super helpful and responsive. They have a beautiful cozy place. There was more than enough space to house us while we were doing some work in Rangley. I would highly recommend.

name: Katrina
review: Clean, awesome view, quick responses from host, easy check in and easy access to surrounding attractions. Would definitely stay there again! Hope the ski resort opens again soon!

name: Gene
review: Amazing views, close to good hunting and fishing areas. Almost right on the ski resort, just an all around terrific place to stay.

name: Margot
review: Ryan saved our tangled up road trip with a quick overnight at his mountain top nest!  It’s a great location with what seems like a fabulous view ( we had rain & fog). It’s a super cozy, comfy spot with thoughtful amenities!

name: Julia
review: Our crew had a great time at Ryan's place on Saddleback Mountain! It was very clean and comfortable and offered all that we were looking for! Hope to come back again!

name: Kate
review: With gorgeous views of Saddleback Lake, 23 Green Drake is a very convenient, cozy and family friendly condo! We highly recommend it!

name: Barbara
review: WOWZA!!! stop looking and just book it! place is amazing. Ryan was a breeze to work with. spotless, nicely furnished and most importantly, fabulous location with views that were out of this world. Bring your favorite beverage, and plan to watch sunset.

name: Karla
review: Second time staying at Ryan’s and already planning our next stay.  Ryans chalet on saddleback mountain was again, perfection.   Great location for hiking, swimming, fishing and relaxing with a beautiful view of the rangeley mountains.  House is comfortable and clean.  Thank you Ryan!!

name: Jennifer
review: Best view in Rangeley. Comfortable condo that my family loved!

name: Nicholas
review: The place was great and the view is amazing. We stayed there in August so it was quite quiet up there.

name: Lydia
review: Stunning location! We had a great overnight stay. Clean house with plenty of space. Had the most amazing views from the deck.

name: Mike
review: The view is amazing. Also sad that the mountain is currently closed but still worth the getaway from real life. Very quiet and peaceful. And moose so that itself is worth the stay. Beautiful. And Ryan is amazing!

name: Peter
review: Had a great stay with an amazing view. Ryan is very responsive and easy to work with!

name: Lars
review: Perfect ski vacation. The condo has everything you need and offers a lot of space. I would book again! Ski in ski out at its best. The kids loved it!

name: Gus
review: FANTASTIC space, right on Saddleback! The house was beautiful and the views were breathtaking. We used this as a stopover for Sugarloaf, and it took us about 45 mins to get there. It’s a beautiful drive through the mountains to get to the Loaf though. Would strongly recommend!

name: Robyn
review: Ryan’s condo was perfect for our weekend get away. It had an everything we needed plus an amazing view!

name: Nick
review: Beautiful, spacious condo with great views!

name: Thomas
review: Great place to stay for a long weekend or vacation. Ryan is easy going and was quick to respond to any questions I had. I would highly recommend Ryan’s condo for anyone looking to spend time in the Rangeley region.

name: Daniel
review: Fantastic view. Well-stocked kitchen. Plenty of parking. Gas fireplace. Short drive to Saddleback lodge. Very nice place. We had a great time. We even had clear dark skies the first night and were able to see the Milky Way.

name: Isabel
review: The condo is comfortable and the location is great. Ryan is a great host. We are already talking about going back!

name: Tika
review: The Airbnb was amazing! Great location and great amenities. Would highly recommend choosing this one for future vacations!

name: Hanna
review: Ryan’s place is awesome! The Mountain View’s are stunning, and the condo is spacious and cozy. Perfect for our family get-a-way. We skied at Sugarloaf (about one hour away) and had lots of fun at Moose Alley with the kids.

name: Caleb
review:
Ryan,
Great spot you have on the mountain. We really enjoyed our time at your place. Thanks for making it available.

name: Brandon
review: Phenomenal place to stay. Everything was great and the view was amazing. 10/10 recommend and will definitely be staying here again.

name: Amanda
review: Even more beautiful in person! perfect ski in/out location with gorgeous mountain views! Saddleback is a great community and we felt refreshed and relaxed after our trip!

name: Matthew
review: Great views and easy access to Saddleback.

name: Ginny
review: Had a great week skiing at Saddleback with our family. The house was perfect and our kids had an awesome time skiing. Highly recommend booking - and we will be back!

name: Liz
review: Fabulous stay, really comfortable, great touches and fabulous.

name: Lisa
review: Ryan’s place is comfy and cozy which makes it so easy to rest and relax. We felt at home right when we walked through the door. The beautiful view of the mountains is breathtaking and peaceful. The location is spot on and it is so easy to ski right onto the mountain and then back again. Our next visit to Ryan’s place can’t come soon enough. See you soon Saddleback!

name: Melissa
review: The place was appropriately decorated in a snow ski cozy theme. There was plenty of room and a nice open feel for the common areas. The location is great for skiing or beautiful views overlooking the trees and landscape.

name: Mike
review: Ryan's space was super clean and stylish. A lot of nice decorative touches. Gorgeous views of the valley and lake below, as well as the mountains beyond.

name: Holly
review: Ryan is an EXCELLENT host!  Very accommodating and quick to respond to any questions.  This was a wonderful experience!

name: Kathy
review: Rangeley has a cute downtown area with great dining options. The view from the condo is magnificent!

name: Hyunwoo
review: Great place and outstanding view! We will be coming back again 100%!

name: Jeffrey
review: Perfect location to ski saddleback.  Comfy and clean.  Thank you.

name: Kelli
review: Beautiful views!  Great place!  Very clean!

name: Tim
review: Awesome place, ski in ski out, plenty of room.  Best of all you can’t hear the kids when they are downstairs. Already planning another trip!

name: Brandon
review: Ryan was a great host and very accommodating everytime I reached out to him!! I look much forward to spending another vacation at this Condo... The house and beautiful town of Rangeley will not dissapoint, I promise!!!!

name: Mohammed
review: Very beautiful Airbnb and beautiful surroundings.

name: Brian
review: This amazing place is a true ski lover's paradise. We can't wait to get back there! Ryan was an amazing host and was over the top accommodating. If you want to experience saddleback the right way, book a stay here.

name: Michelle
review: We've had at least four stays at Ryan's place (see my previous reviews) and we've already booked next Christmas. It has become our home-away-from-home for 2-4 days every year, and there's nowhere we'd rather be while enjoying the western mountain region of Maine.

name: Frank
review: Quite relaxing, in a great location with super views. Looking forward to going back again soon.

name: Kirstie Mae
review: Best host we had! Extremely helpful and considerate. He always answered our calls regarding questions and helped us through our problem when we got stuck in the winter storm getting there.

name: Thia
review: This experience on the mountain was all we had hoped for .  Stunning views , great sleeping , cozy open living room/dining /kitchen plan… had everything we needed for a family fun ski trip . Thank you Ryan !

name: Charlotte
review: Gorgeous location and condo! Zero complaints, highly recommend staying here if you’re visiting the Rangeley region.

name: Anna
review: The views themselves make this place 100% worth the money. We would love to come back again soon!

name: Travis
review: Excellent place to stay. Beautiful place with an awesome view!

name: Grace
review: Loved the place! Had a great stay.

name: Meghan
review: Ryan was an upbeat, communicative host from the start of booking. Outstanding space, views and location to the slopes. Highly recommend!

name: Shane
review: we loved our stay at Ryan's place. it's in a great location right on mountain, the views are gorgeous, and the condo is in great shape with plenty of beds. Ryan was very responsive and accommodating.

name: Melissa
review: Despite some unforeseen circumstances, the stay was great overall and Ryan was a great and responsive host. We loved our visit to Maine and would definitely come back.

name: Brian
review: Fantastic mountainside accommodations. Beautiful setting. Plenty of room for the whole crew.

name: Chris
review: Stylish and comfortable with great views. The quick walk to the trail was convenient for spending the whole day going on and off the mountain.

name: Mackenzie
review: Beautiful, clean condo for a reasonable price!

name: Tallin
review: Great deal for such a new and unique place with the greatest view of the New England Fall colors. Can’t wait to rebook. Ryan was a  great host.

name: Lisa
review: Great views and comfortable space. The slope side access is very convenient!

name: Molly
review: Ryan's place made a perfect spot for our crew of friends, pups and kids to gather. The location can't be beat, and makes for quick and easy access to the slopes, right out the front door. We look forward to continuing this annual tradition!

name: Jami
review: Great place to stay! I loved the location and stylish space! Definitely will be back !

name: Andrew
review: This is the second year I've stayed here for a golf weekend, great place with beautiful views.

name: Mackenzie
review: Great place to stay with wonderful views!

name: Samar
review: Excellent stay.

name: Jamie
